newsitem.title: USA: Grand Union says CEO Joseph McCaig resigns.
newsitem.headline: Grand Union says CEO Joseph McCaig resigns.

text.p: Grand Union Co said Wednesday Joseph McCaig has resigned as president and chief executive because of differences with the board of directors on how best to achieve Grand Union's long-term objectives.
The company said it searching for a replacement for McCaig, whose resignation is effective immediately.
The company said that in the interim, it will be managed by a four member office of the chairman. Roger Stangeland, chairman of the board, will be interim chief executive officer.
The company said McCaig had been president and chief executive since 1989.
